# Rules reference

Rule pack **`example-1.0`** - source: Example logging guide v1.0 (sample rule pack).
These rules are enforced by the engine on every proposed row, whatever AI tool you use.

## Account routing

| Situation | Account |
|---|---|
| Customer exists | the customer |
| None, several customers, or internal (events, training, multi-customer sessions) | Example Corp (12345678) |
| Partner enablement | the partner |
| Partner deal | the customer, not the partner, so the deal links |

## Activity types (drop-down order)

| Type | When to use |
|---|---|
| 01 · Pipeline Generation | Work that creates or moves forward new opportunities: events, workshops and outreach to prospects. |
| 02 · Discovery Call | Conversations with a customer or prospect to learn their goals, environment, problems and what a good result looks like. |
| 03 · Executive Briefing | Material or sessions prepared for a customer's senior leaders: summaries, recommendations and leadership presentations. |
| 04 · Technical Talk | Preparing or giving a technical presentation, architecture discussion or whiteboard session that does not include a live demo. |
| 05 · Technical Review | Checking a customer's environment, requirements, integrations or readiness, including technical workshops, to see whether a solution fits. |
| 06 · RFP/RFI | Reading, answering or checking a formal request for proposal or information, a questionnaire or a list of customer requirements. |
| 07 · Product Demo | Preparing, giving or following up a demonstration of the product against a customer's needs or use cases. |
| 08 · Value Review | A structured review of the value a customer would get. Treat it as a single record that collects hours over time, and write the start and end dates in the notes. |
| 09 · POC/POV | A formal proof of concept or proof of value: planning, set-up, running it, testing against the agreed success measures, and presenting the results. |
| 10 · Support - Partner | Technical help for a partner on an opportunity, a demo, positioning or a joint customer engagement. Not formal partner education. |
| 11 · Support - Services | Technical help for the services or consulting team: background on the solution, design questions and hand-over. |
| 12 · Support - Customer Care | Technical help for the customer care team to understand, reproduce or solve a customer's technical issue. |
| 13 · Support - Marketing | Helping the marketing team with talks, events, campaigns and technical content. |
| 14 · Support - Specialist Team | Technical help for a specialist team, for example on business cases, value assessments or customer workshops. |
| 15 · Support - Peer | Helping a colleague on the same team: coaching, shadowing, working through a problem or preparing for a customer meeting. |
| 16 · Enablement - Partner | Structured technical teaching or enablement given to partners. |
| 17 · Enablement - Customer | Structured technical teaching given to customers: sessions, workshops and bootcamps. |
| 18 · Enablement - Internal | Structured technical teaching for colleagues: product training, knowledge sharing and team events. |
| 19 · Delivery - General | Customer-facing technical help after a sale that is not part of a named programme: adoption, guidance and hand-over. |
| 20 · Delivery - Quick Start | A short guided start-up engagement: planning, enablement, set-up and checking. If you give a demo during it, record the demo as its own Product Demo. |
| 21 · Delivery - Outcome Tracking | After-sale work that measures and shows the results a customer has achieved: reviews and outcome tracking. |
| 22 · Team Administration | Setting up, looking after and fixing the team's own demo or test environments. Getting an environment ready for a single demo belongs under Product Demo. |

## Field values

- **Status:** Completed, In Progress, Planned, Cancelled (default Completed)
- **Solution Area:** AIOps, Discovery, ITSM, ESM, Other - optional; 'Other' needs 'Other: ...' in Notes
- **One record per engagement** (hours accrue, Activity Date = latest): 06 · RFP/RFI, 08 · Value Review, 09 · POC/POV
- **Opportunity expected:** 06 · RFP/RFI, 08 · Value Review, 09 · POC/POV
- **Partner account is right for:** 10 · Support - Partner, 16 · Enablement - Partner (partner enablement); deals are logged under the customer

## Checks

| Check | Effect | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| C01 | Blocks commit | Activity type is one of the 22 logging guide types |
| C02 | Blocks commit | Status is Completed, In Progress, Planned or Cancelled |
| C03 | Blocks commit | Activity Hours above 0 - or '[to confirm]', which holds the row |
| C04 | Blocks commit | Hours are within the evidence; prep-titled meetings count only as prep; user-confirmed hours need a user: ref |
| C05 | Blocks commit | Account routing: exact registry name; internal = Example Corp; partner deals go to the customer |
| C06 | Blocks commit | No opportunity means a 'Reason (no opportunity)' - or '[to confirm]', which holds the row |
| C07 | Warning | RFP/RFI, Value Review and POC/POV should link an opportunity |
| C08 | Blocks commit | One record per Value Review / POC-POV / RFP: needs a consolidation key; extend instead of duplicating |
| C09 | Blocks commit | Long-running records: Activity Date = latest date; Value Review Notes state start and end dates |
| C10 | Blocks commit | A demo inside a POC/POV or Quick Start is logged separately as 07 Product Demo |
| C11 | Warning | Environment prep for one demo is 07 Product Demo, not 22 Team Administration |
| C12 | Blocks commit | Every row cites evidence that exists and was not filtered out as noise |
| C13 | Blocks commit | Activity Date matches a date in the cited evidence |
| C14 | Blocks commit | Solution Area values are valid; 'Other' needs 'Other: ...' in Notes |
| C15 | Blocks commit | Notes describe what was done, in detail |
| C16 | Blocks commit | Evidence already logged in another row cannot be logged again |
| C17 | Warning | Activity Date lies outside the run period |
| C18 | Blocks commit | Confidence is High, Medium or Low |
| C19 | Blocks commit | Extend/void targets an active record with the same consolidation key |
| C20 | Blocks commit | Primary Owner is set (from the profile) |
| C21 | Warning | Two rows cite meetings that overlap in time |

A row whose hours, account or no-opportunity reason is `[to confirm]` is valid but **held**:
it is kept in the ledger and left out of Paste-Ready until you resolve it.
